preconditions.description: The number of vertices V is between 1 and 10^4 inclusive.
The number of edges E is between 0 and 10^4 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= u < V and 0 <= v < V for u in range(V) for v in adj[u])
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two vertices within the range 0 to V-1.

preconditions.expression: all(u != v for u in range(V) for v in adj[u])
preconditions.description: The graph does not contain self-loops.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= node < V for node in return_value)
postconditions.description: Each node in the return value is within the range 0 to V-1.

postconditions.expression: all(node in return_value for node in terminal_nodes)
postconditions.description: All terminal nodes are included in the return value.

postconditions.expression: all(all(lead_to_terminal(node, adj) for node in return_value))
postconditions.description: Every path starting from each node in the return value leads to a terminal node.
The return value is sorted in ascending order.
